caption: The drawing depicts a single doll seated against a plain, light-colored background. The doll has a pale face with two visible black dots on the cheeks, round black eyes, small red lips, and dark, curly, stylized hair. The doll wears a fitted high-necked bodice and a full skirt, both rendered in light blue with small, repeating red and blue marks as pattern details. Over its dress, the doll wears a dark blue jacket with shading to suggest folds in the fabric. Its hands are depicted with a brownish color, and it wears black shoes with visible ties. The doll's skirt fans out around it in a circular manner, occupying much of the composition. There are no additional objects, scenery, or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Doll
